title: Hyperscale Data Center Power Use Estimated at 1.8% of 2024 U.S. Total

meta.summary:
A new study calculates roughly 400 U.S. hyperscale data centers drew a combined 82 TWh of electricity from May 2024 to April 2025, or about 1.8% of total U.S. power consumption. 
 The post  Hyperscale Data Center Power Use Estimated at 1.8% of 2024 U.S. Total  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
